labour.title: 28% CGT on investment and commercial property profits
labour.summary: Official PDF after RNZ weekend leak: flat 28% on net gains after 1 July 2027 on sale of commercial/residential investment property (family home exempt). Revenue ring-fenced for health including three free GP visits.
labour.rateOrThreshold: 28% on gains after 1 July 2027; family home/farms exempt

labour.title: CGT valuation-day details largely post-election
labour.summary: Reported: valuation methodology and defaults largely deferred until after the election (Tax Working Group options).

labour.title: Not campaigning on a wealth tax
labour.summary: Labour says the only new tax it campaigns on is the property CGT; wealth tax left to partners in any coalition.
labour.rateOrThreshold: n/a — not a 2026 Labour campaign wealth tax

labour.title: Raise GST registration threshold to $80,000
labour.summary: Compulsory GST registration threshold raised from $60,000 to $80,000 from 1 July 2028 (not a cut in the 15% GST rate).

labour.title: Repeal Investment Boost incentive
labour.summary: Fiscal plan books revenue from repealing National's Investment Boost (20% upfront deduction for qualifying new assets); not a change to the 28% headline company rate.
labour.rateOrThreshold: Repeal Investment Boost (headline company rate unchanged)

labour.title: Strengthen KiwiSaver (employer-led)
labour.summary: Compulsory employer contributions from 1 July 2028 rising to 6% by 2032; default employee 4%; parental leave and over-65 employer contributions.
labour.rateOrThreshold: Employer to 6% by 2032; compulsory from 1 July 2028

labour.title: ETS review / stronger carbon price (not a carbon tax)
labour.summary: Urgent ETS review aiming for a meaningful carbon price; pause new forestry ETS registrations during review; will not campaign on agricultural emissions pricing.

labour.title: Streaming services levy — denied
labour.summary: Hipkins ruled out a streamers levy; related member's bill removed from ballot — not election policy.

labour.title: Reverse tobacco excise cut
labour.summary: Fiscal plan includes reversing National's tobacco tax cut as a revenue line.
labour.rateOrThreshold: See fiscal plan table for amounts

green.title: Fair income tax restructure
green.summary: Tax-free first $10,000 and stepped bands up to 45% over $160,000; party says 96% get a tax cut. Document also appeared online before the launch press conference.

green.title: 2.5% wealth tax on net assets above $10m
green.summary: Annual tax on net assets above $10m per individual ($20m couple framing in some coverage); family home exempt; trust attribution rules.

green.title: Capital Acquisitions Tax 33%
green.summary: 33% on assets/gifts received over $1m; family home and family farms exempt.

green.title: 33% company tax for large corporates
green.summary: 33% for firms with turnover over $30m; keep 28% for SMEs.

green.title: Bank levy 0.06%
green.summary: 0.06% p.a. on liabilities of banks with over $100b liabilities (big four).

green.title: 10-year bright-line + reverse interest deductibility
green.summary: Restore 10-year bright-line on residential investment; remove interest deductibility for residential investors; gains taxed at marginal rates under bright-line (not Labour's flat 28% CGT).
green.rateOrThreshold: 10-year bright-line; marginal rates on taxed gain

green.title: Big tech offshore profit withholding
green.summary: Enforce 5% withholding on profits shifted offshore via misclassified royalties/service fees.

national.title: No new taxes pledge
national.summary: Campaign promise of no new taxes; ruled out bank tax and accommodation/bed levy. Has not ruled out raising existing taxes/fees.

national.title: No capital gains tax
national.summary: Commits to no CGT under the no-new-taxes frame and campaigns against Labour's property CGT.

national.title: No wealth tax
national.summary: Framed as part of no-new-taxes versus partners' wealth taxes.

national.title: Compulsory KiwiSaver to 12% by 2032
national.summary: Compulsory for workers from 1 July 2028; default employee/employer rates rise to 6% each by 1 April 2032; Baby Boost $1,500; parental leave and over-65 employer contributions.

national.title: Student loan repayment rate cut to 10%
national.summary: Reduce compulsory repayment from 12% to 10% on income above $24,128 from 1 April 2027 for NZ-based borrowers; tougher overseas recovery.

national.title: Bracket creep / income-tax adjustment signalled
national.summary: Willis said National will campaign on addressing bracket creep and make an income-tax announcement during the campaign, but not before books return to surplus. No rates published as of 2026-10-11.

act.title: No tax on KiwiSaver investment earnings
act.summary: Tax-free qualifying fund earnings; end government KiwiSaver contribution for members with employer contributions; party PDF costings ~$2.4b over four years.

act.title: Scrap Net Zero / cut carbon tax / Carbon Tax Refund
act.summary: Repeal Zero Carbon Act framing; remove ETS auction price floor; return 100% of net auction revenue to households; oppose agricultural emissions tax.
act.rateOrThreshold: Remove minimum auction price; refund net auction revenue

act.title: Oppose CGT and wealth taxes
act.summary: Economy policy opposes punishing savers; framed against CGT/wealth taxes and compulsory KiwiSaver-plus-tax packages.

act.title: No fresh 2026 costed income-tax table found
act.summary: Older Alternative Budget bracket ideas exist in legacy materials; no new 2026 bracket PDF located on act.org.nz in this pass.

nz-first.title: 20% company tax for SMEs under $30m turnover
nz-first.summary: Cut company tax from 28% to 20% for companies with turnover under $30 million; party estimates ~$1b initial annual fiscal cost.

nz-first.title: Withdraw from Paris Accord
nz-first.summary: Announced policy to withdraw from the Paris Accord and resist emissions pricing without trading-partner parity (separate from company-tax announcement).
nz-first.rateOrThreshold: Exit Paris; condition emissions pricing on peers

nz-first.title: No 2026 PAYE restructure on policy hub
nz-first.summary: Policy index emphasises SME company tax; no PAYE bands on nzfirst.nz pages checked this pass.

nz-first.title: No CGT proposal found
nz-first.summary: No capital gains tax proposal on the 2026 policy hub pages checked.

nz-first.title: No wealth tax proposal found
nz-first.summary: No wealth tax proposal on the 2026 policy hub pages checked.

te-pati-maori.title: Kiwi Tax Plan income-tax scale
te-pati-maori.summary: Zero tax on first $30,000; progressive bands to 48% above $300,001; party says most people pay less income tax.

te-pati-maori.title: Tiered net wealth tax above $2m
te-pati-maori.summary: Progressive annual tax on net wealth above $2m per person.

te-pati-maori.title: 5% stamp duty on residential sales
te-pati-maori.summary: 5% on residential sales; first-home buyers exempt for homes under $1m (buyer-side transaction tax, distinct from Labour CGT).

te-pati-maori.title: 33% land-banking tax + 2% vacant house tax
te-pati-maori.summary: Kiwi Tax Plan: 33% land-banking tax and 2% annual vacant house tax.

te-pati-maori.title: Company tax to 33%
te-pati-maori.summary: Return headline company rate from 28% to 33%.

te-pati-maori.title: Kai credit / No GST on kai framing
te-pati-maori.summary: Targeted credit for earners at or under $60,000 framed as equivalent to weeks of kai; separate members' bill seeks GST removal from food.
te-pati-maori.rateOrThreshold: Credit for earners <= $60k; GST-off-food bill separate

te-pati-maori.title: 5% international profit transfer tax
te-pati-maori.summary: 5% on value of profits transferred offshore.

opportunity.title: Tax Reset income scale + Citizen's Income
opportunity.summary: Three personal brackets plus universal Citizen's Income for adults 18+; replaces most main benefits with top-ups (Tax Reset PDF).

opportunity.title: National land value tax
opportunity.summary: Annual tax on unimproved land value to fund Citizen's Income; exemptions/deferrals for some public/Maori/social uses, retirees, farmers. Transition starts lower on urban land.

opportunity.title: KiwiSaver 2.0 compulsory to 12%
opportunity.summary: Compulsory contributions rising to 6% employee + 6% employer; contributions and fund income progressively tax-exempt; NZ Super replaced by CI + top-up with no cut vs current Super.

opportunity.title: Strengthen ETS; ring-fence auction revenue
opportunity.summary: Restore credible rising ETS price path; direct Crown ETS auction revenue to Industry Energy Resilience Fund.
opportunity.rateOrThreshold: Revenue ring-fencing (no new ETS price stated)

opportunity.title: No CGT in Tax Reset (LVT preferred)
opportunity.summary: Tax Reset does not propose a capital gains tax; party favours land value tax plus universal income instead.

alliance.title: First $20,000 tax-free + rebalanced scale
alliance.summary: Costed plan: tax-free first $20k; progressive rates up to a 47% top bracket; lower/middle earners pay less.

alliance.title: 2.5% wealth tax above $2m + trust measure
alliance.summary: Annual tax on individual net wealth above $2m (~$4m couple); companion trust tax closes avoidance.

alliance.title: 33% CGT on realised gains (family home exempt)
alliance.summary: Broad CGT on investment property, shares, business assets; family home excluded; applies to gains after commencement.

alliance.title: Company tax to 30%
alliance.summary: Increase company tax from 28% to 30% with behavioural adjustment in costings.

alliance.title: 0.1% financial transactions levy
alliance.summary: Levy on equity and onshore FX turnover; wages, bills, KiwiSaver contributions exempt.

alliance.title: Replace ETS with carbon tax
alliance.summary: Scrap ETS for a direct carbon tax; revenue to renewables/PT/efficiency; protect low-income households. Rate not specified in environment PDF.
alliance.rateOrThreshold: Carbon tax rate not specified in PDF

alliance.title: $10,000 KiwiSaver endowment; Super at 65
alliance.summary: Keep NZ Super at 65; $10,000 automatic endowment to new KiwiSaver accounts; couple rate lift toward 72.5% of net average wage cap.

vision.title: First $25,000 tax-free
vision.summary: First $25,000 of personal income tax-free; also abolish income tax on superannuation, student loans, and welfare benefits.

vision.title: Higher tax on non-compliant foreign firms
vision.summary: Higher tax rate on foreign traders/businesses failing a local employment baseline (rate not specified).
vision.rateOrThreshold: Higher rate if local employment baseline unmet (rate n/a)

vision.title: Leave Paris Accord
vision.summary: Leave Paris Accord as part of sovereignty / climate regulation rollback.

vision.title: No CGT proposal found
vision.summary: No capital gains tax proposal on Vision policies page checked.

nz-loyal.title: 1% financial transaction tax replacing other taxes
nz-loyal.summary: 1% on electronic payments, cash withdrawals, online transactions, securities trades; framed as replacing income tax, GST, company tax and eliminating Inland Revenue.

nz-loyal.title: Abolish income tax (replaced by FTT)
nz-loyal.summary: Conventional income tax eliminated under the 1% transaction tax model.

nz-loyal.title: Abolish GST (replaced by FTT)
nz-loyal.summary: GST eliminated under the 1% transaction tax model.

nz-loyal.title: Abolish company tax (replaced by FTT)
nz-loyal.summary: Company tax eliminated under the same model.

conservative.title: Lower personal tax (direction)
conservative.summary: Press for lower individual rates competitive with Australia; no numeric schedule published on economy page.
conservative.rateOrThreshold: Direction only — no full scale published

conservative.title: Align company tax with top personal rate
conservative.summary: Corporation tax aligned with top income tax rate (top rate not specified on page).
conservative.rateOrThreshold: Aligned to top personal rate (rate n/a)

conservative.title: Leave Paris; scrap climate energy taxes
conservative.summary: Leave Paris Agreement; scrap fossil-fuel taxes/restrictions based on climate ideology framing.

conservative.title: NZ Super not taxable
conservative.summary: Remove NZ Super from taxable income so working superannuitants are not taxed on Super.

te-tai-tokerau.title: Universal Whanau Allowance + MSD debt amnesty
te-tai-tokerau.summary: Non-taxable allowance replacing punitive MSD system; about $2b MSD/IRD debt amnesty.
te-tai-tokerau.rateOrThreshold: Allowance amount not specified; ~$2b debt amnesty

te-tai-tokerau.title: 5-year innovator regional corporate tax holiday
te-tai-tokerau.summary: Businesses in regional incubators: 100% exemption from regional corporate income tax for first 5 years if local payroll/staff targets met.

te-tai-tokerau.title: Local food trade free of state transaction taxes
te-tai-tokerau.summary: Hyper-local barter/sale free of state transaction taxes (Te Tauhokohoko).
te-tai-tokerau.rateOrThreshold: n/a — exemption for local food trade

te-tai-tokerau.title: No national income-tax scale
te-tai-tokerau.summary: No national personal income-tax schedule on our-policies page.

animal-justice.title: GST off plant foods and veterinary services
animal-justice.summary: Zero-rate GST on fruit, vegetables, legumes, nuts; remove GST on all veterinary services.
animal-justice.rateOrThreshold: 0% on listed plant foods and vet services

animal-justice.title: Split ETS + biogenic scheme + pollution tax
animal-justice.summary: Fossil ETS separate from biogenic cap-and-trade; pollution tax on pesticides/fertilisers escalating over time; revenue to farm transition fund.

animal-justice.title: No income-tax scale published
animal-justice.summary: No personal income-tax schedule on policy summary/transition materials checked.

alcp.title: Cannabis/hemp taxation (rate unspecified)
alcp.summary: Regulated R18 commerce expected to generate taxation revenue and redirect prohibition spend to health/education; no rate or model on policy page.

alcp.title: No income-tax schedule
alcp.summary: No income-tax schedule on ALCP policy page.

alcp.title: No GST proposal
alcp.summary: No GST proposal on ALCP policy page.

womens-rights.title: Working for Families / tax credit reform
womens-rights.summary: Supports folding In Work Tax Credit into Family Tax Credit; index WFF to wages; lower abatement rates — not a full income-tax scale.

womens-rights.title: KiwiSaver equity for carers and women
womens-rights.summary: State contributions to carers' KiwiSaver; employer KiwiSaver during maternity leave; pay equity framing.

womens-rights.title: Living wages and benefits
womens-rights.summary: Increase minimum wages and benefits to living incomes; pay equity; affordable childcare.

outdoors-freedom.title: Exit Paris; avoid offshore carbon credit bills
outdoors-freedom.summary: Oppose Paris Accord; cites multi-billion cost of buying international credits; focus on local mitigation not ETS payments offshore.
outdoors-freedom.rateOrThreshold: Exit Paris / avoid offshore credit purchases

outdoors-freedom.title: Tax unhealthy food
outdoors-freedom.summary: Pae Ora submission: unhealthy foods should be taxed to cover their true costs (rate not specified).

outdoors-freedom.title: No income-tax schedule found
outdoors-freedom.summary: No clear income-tax scale on nzofp.co.nz pages checked.

free-palestine.summary: Party site focuses on Palestine foreign-policy justice; no domestic tax proposals found on pages checked.

free-palestine.summary: No clear published proposal for this instrument on materials checked as of 2026-10-11.
